blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Navotas Rep. Toby Tiangco filed a resolution urging the House of Representatives to allow its own budget to be scrutinized and undergo committee deliberations, according to a statement released by his office on Tuesday. Tiangco introduced House Resolution No. 1590 on Monday, which calls on the House to submit its proposed 2027 budget to the chamber’s appropriations committee for review, reopen plenary debates, and submit any amendments to the Senate. He said a review of the House’s budget can be executed quickly without delaying discussions on the spending plan, as the Senate holds its own discussions on the […]...
